# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on npm gets fixes.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 2.x     | yes       |
| < 2.0   | no        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through [GitHub's advisory form](https://github.com/RusticStack/pico-reforged/security/advisories/new) or by email to hello@rusticstack.com. Please do not open a public issue.

Include the version, what an attacker can do, and the steps or a small reproduction. You will get a reply within a week. Once a fix is out, the advisory is published with credit to you unless you ask otherwise.

The stylesheets contain no JavaScript, so most reports will concern the CLI, the compiler or the Vite and PostCSS plugins.
